question: Should the agent activity timeline be implemented as a UI/CLI view on top of the metadata-only audit ledger, or narrowed/deferred after that foundation lands?
rationale: Current main has partial live Activity and trajectory tools, while open related work owns durable audit and subagent lifecycle semantics; choosing the product boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Build on audit foundation
options.body: Keep this issue as the user-facing CLI/chat/TUI/export view that depends on the metadata-only audit ledger direction.

options.title: Narrow to visual timeline
options.body: Limit this issue to a Control UI or TUI timeline after persistence is settled and leave CLI/export to the audit issue.

options.title: Defer standalone timeline
options.body: Treat current Activity plus trajectory tooling as sufficient until a maintainer sponsors a concrete timeline design.

recommendation.title: Build on audit foundation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the user-facing CLI/chat/TUI/export view that depends on the metadata-only audit ledger direction.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-history and related-direction owner for the audit, state, and product boundary choice.
